name: zero days + personality test (pilot)
description: PERSONALITY PILOT 2026-10-25: no given record; the BFI-2-XS on day 1 and again on day 2, nothing before it. The point of departure.

roles.name: Ola
roles.description: day 1 — the personality test, fifteen BFI-2-XS items, verbatim.
roles.instruction:
[VERBATIM]
Hi Maya, I'm Ola, a researcher. I will read you fifteen short statements about what you are like. For each one, please answer with a number from 1 to 5: 1 means strongly disagree, 5 means strongly agree. You may add a sentence if you want. The first statement: I am someone who tends to be quiet.
Next: I am someone who is compassionate, has a soft heart.
Next: I am someone who tends to be disorganized.
Next: I am someone who worries a lot.
Next: I am someone who is fascinated by art, music, or literature.
Next: I am someone who is dominant, acts as a leader.
Next: I am someone who is sometimes rude to others.
Next: I am someone who has difficulty getting started on tasks.
Next: I am someone who tends to feel depressed, blue.
Next: I am someone who has little interest in abstract ideas.
Next: I am someone who is full of energy.
Next: I am someone who assumes the best about people.
Next: I am someone who is reliable, can always be counted on.
Next: I am someone who is emotionally stable, not easily upset.
Next: I am someone who is original, comes up with new ideas.
